title: Failing test: running the Gauntlet tests leaves the tracked ledger byte-identical
goal: A committed test fails on main: it hashes evals/gauntlet/ledger.json, runs test/gauntlet.test.mjs (or the full suite) as a child process, and asserts the file is byte-identical afterwards
acceptance: Test committed before the fix and failing on main (under load if needed: run the Gauntlet tests with the concurrency the full suite uses), or the record names why it cannot fail on demand and the manual check that replaces it
It restores the tracked file if the run changed it, so the failing test itself never leaves a rewritten ledger behind
A second, narrower test: a Gauntlet command whose NERV_GAUNTLET_LEDGER changes between read and write still writes only the file it read
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: 1.5 h agent. Implemented the same day: test/gauntlet-ledger.test.mjs; fails on main (all three tests), the ledger restored by the test. Remaining: CI. Closed 2026-11-26.
